items.title_zh: 智谱 MaaS 平台上线数据内容不留存机制，用户可申请开通
items.title_en: Zhipu's MaaS Platform Launches No-Data-Retention Mechanism, Users Can Apply to Enable It
items.summary_zh: 智谱 MaaS 平台上线数据内容不留存机制，用户可申请开通 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: Zhipu has rolled out a no-data-retention mechanism on its MaaS platform, which users can apply to enable. The company has not yet disclosed the technical details, scope or effective date of the feature.
items.why_zh: 数据留存政策是企业客户选用大模型 API 时最关心的安全议题之一，提供“不留存”选项有助于智谱争取对数据敏感的行业客户。
items.why_en: Data-retention policy is one of the top security concerns for enterprises using LLM APIs, so a no-retention option could help Zhipu win privacy-sensitive business customers.

items.title_zh: 智谱MaaS平台上线数据内容不留存机制
items.title_en: Zhipu MaaS Platform Adds No-Data-Retention Mechanism
items.summary_zh: 智谱MaaS平台上线数据内容不留存机制 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Zhipu says its MaaS platform now offers a no-data-retention mechanism that users can apply to activate. No further details on coverage or implementation have been disclosed.
items.why_zh: 在大模型服务竞争加剧的背景下，数据不留存承诺正成为厂商争取企业客户信任的标配能力。
items.why_en: As competition among LLM service providers intensifies, no-data-retention pledges are becoming a standard way to earn enterprise trust.

items.title_zh: 智谱将上线“零数据留存”机制
items.title_en: Zhipu to Launch 'Zero Data Retention' Mechanism
items.summary_zh: 智谱将上线“零数据留存”机制 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Zhipu is set to introduce a 'zero data retention' mechanism under which it keeps no user data content, tied to its MaaS platform and available on request. Timing and technical details remain undisclosed.
items.why_zh: “零数据留存”直接触及企业客户在合规与商业秘密保护上的核心顾虑，是云与模型服务商的重要差异化卖点。
items.why_en: Zero data retention directly addresses enterprise worries about compliance and trade-secret protection, making it a key differentiator for cloud and model vendors.

items.title_zh: 智谱MaaS平台将上线数据不留存功能
items.title_en: Zhipu MaaS Platform to Add Data Non-Retention Feature
items.summary_zh: 智谱MaaS平台将上线数据不留存功能 donews.com
items.summary_en: Zhipu's MaaS platform is expected to add a data non-retention feature that users can apply for. The company has not detailed when it goes live or which services it covers.
items.why_zh: 此类机制关系到大模型 API 使用中的数据边界，是企业评估供应商合规能力时的关键参考项。
items.why_en: Such a mechanism defines the data boundary for LLM API usage and is a key factor enterprises weigh when assessing a vendor's compliance.

items.title_zh: 刚刚融完335亿，智谱就卷入“偷传数据”风波
items.title_en: Fresh Off 33.5 Billion Yuan Raise, Zhipu Hit by 'Secretly Transmitting Data' Controversy
items.summary_zh: 刚刚融完335亿，智谱就卷入“偷传数据”风波 Sohu
items.summary_en: Zhipu is said to have become embroiled in a 'secretly transmitting data' controversy shortly after completing a 33.5 billion yuan funding round. Details of the allegations and any company response were not disclosed in the available summary.
items.why_zh: 数据安全指控出现在巨额融资之后，可能直接影响智谱在政企市场的信誉与商业拓展节奏。
items.why_en: A data-security allegation arriving right after a huge funding round could directly affect Zhipu's reputation and momentum in government and enterprise markets.

items.title_zh: 古尔曼：苹果最快下月推出智能家居屏幕设备，iPhone Duo 专属手写笔计划夭折
items.title_en: Gurman: Apple May Unveil Smart Home Screen as Soon as Next Month; iPhone Duo Stylus Plan Scrapped
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，据彭博社记者马克 · 古尔曼（Mark Gurman）报道，苹果“个人智能中枢”AI 战略，暗示新款家用设备即将到来。报道称，苹果全新的“智能个人中枢”战略，其意义远不止局限于 iPhone。此外：苹果对 Fitness+ 业务实施了裁员，该服务未来走向存疑；iPhone Duo 专属手写笔计划已经夭折；Apple Pay 即将正式登陆印度。 IT之家附报道内容如下： 本月，约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）以苹果新任首席执行官的身份发表了自己的首场主题演讲。演讲开头几分钟，他阐述了自己对于人工智能时代下设备发展的愿景。 他请观众设想：从零开始设计一台理想的 AI 设备。这款产品需要可以永久联网、配备尺寸合适的显示屏、顶级的摄像头与麦克风，同时还要拥有优秀的续航。特努斯还补充，它必须易于使用，并且可以和其他硬件、软件以及各项服务协同工作。 这番表述，让台下听众感觉他马上就要发布一款突破性新品，用来和市面上越来越多专门面向 AI 的硬件产品展开竞争。演讲感染力极强，甚至苹果内部不少员工都以为，他接下来就要正式推出传闻已久的家用 AI 中枢设备。 然而，特努斯想传递的观点与此截然不同。在他看来，这台理想 AI 设备其实早已问世 —— 就是 iPhone 本身。他会发表这番言论并不令人意外。眼下 OpenAI 即将发布以 AI 为核心的专用计算机，…
items.summary_en: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that Apple is advancing a 'personal intelligent hub' AI strategy pointing to a new home device, possibly a smart home screen as soon as next month. He also reports layoffs at Fitness+, the cancellation of a stylus for iPhone Duo, and Apple Pay's imminent arrival in India.
items.why_zh: 古尔曼的爆料勾勒出苹果在 AI 硬件与家庭场景的下一步动作，也折射出它在 OpenAI 等对手推出 AI 专用设备时的战略取舍。
items.why_en: Gurman's report sketches Apple's next moves in AI hardware and the home, revealing its strategic trade-offs as rivals such as OpenAI push dedicated AI devices.

items.title_zh: 2026 年上半年，我国制造业人工智能重点场景应用普及率达 34.2%
items.title_en: China's Manufacturing AI Adoption in Key Scenarios Reaches 34.2% in First Half of 2026
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，据新华社报道，9 月 20 日，在安徽省合肥市举办的 2026 世界制造业大会上，国家工业信息安全发展研究中心发布的《制造业数智化转型能力水平（2026）》显示， 今年上半年，我国制造业人工智能重点场景应用普及率达 34.2% ，全国两化融合发展水平达到 67.1，整体进入数字化、网络化、智能化协同推进的新阶段。 IT之家注：两化融合发展水平是指信息化与工业化在技术、产品、业务和产业等层面深度结合的成熟与发展程度。 报告显示，数字化底座持续夯实，研发设计、生产制造、经营管理等环节实现数字化普及的企业比例分别为 86.3%、69.5%、81.4%；网络化融通纵深拓展，全国近五成的企业开展网络化协同，数字孪生、链网协同、智能生产等新业态、新模式加速涌现；智能化应用加速普及， 人工智能技术重点场景应用普及率达 34.2%，较上年增长 5.5 个百分点，10.6% 的规上制造业企业依托人工智能大模型赋能业务革新 。
items.summary_en: A report released at the 2026 World Manufacturing Convention in Hefei says 34.2% of key manufacturing scenarios in China applied AI in the first half of 2026, up 5.5 percentage points from a year earlier, while the national integration level of informatization and industrialization reached 67.1.
items.why_zh: 官方数据量化了 AI 在中国制造业的真实渗透率，是观察“人工智能+制造”政策成效与落地节奏的关键指标。
items.why_en: The official figures quantify AI's real penetration into Chinese manufacturing, a key indicator of how 'AI + manufacturing' policy is translating into practice.

items.title_zh: 阿里千问开源 Qwen-Image-2.1 图像模型：可生成、编辑透明图像，支持最多 10 张参考图
items.title_en: Alibaba's Qwen Open-Sources Qwen-Image-2.1, Supporting Transparent Images and Up to 10 Reference Images
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，阿里千问今日宣布，开源千问图像系列当前兼顾生成效果、推理效率与使用成本的开源图像模型 Qwen-Image-2.1。 Qwen-Image-2.1 将文生图与图像编辑整合在同一模型中，视觉生成部分仅有 7B 参数，并原生支持透明图像的生成与编辑。 官方表示，本次更新的主要特色包括四个方面： 小模强效，极致价比 ：轻量的模型结构与推理优化，在生成质量和计算成本之间取得平衡。 ▲ Qwen-Image-Bench 公开评测对比 原生透明，创改一体 ：根据提示词生成普通图像或透明图像，并支持透明图层编辑与抠图。 ▲ 通过文本直接生成透明图像的示例 全能编辑，多局保全 ：支持最多 10 张参考图 ，增强局部编辑、人像与商品保真，并覆盖多种编辑任务。 ▲ 十张家居参考图生成室内布置 真实质感，字雅人美 ：提升文字排版、人物光影与细节表现，让生成结果更具美感。 ▲ 文字渲染示例 IT之家附相关链接： GitHub： https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-Image-2.1 HuggingFace： https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 ModelScope： https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1
items.summary_en: Alibaba's Qwen has open-sourced Qwen-Image-2.1, a 7B image model that unifies text-to-image generation and editing, natively handles transparent images, accepts up to 10 reference images, and improves text rendering and portrait lighting.
items.why_zh: 把生成与编辑合一、原生支持透明图层，并以 7B 小体量压低推理成本，让开源图像模型更易进入实际生产流程。
items.why_en: Unifying generation and editing with native transparency support at a compact 7B size lowers inference costs and makes open image models more practical for production use.

items.title_en: Zhipu Discloses GLM-5.3: Model Begins Optimizing the Inference System That Runs It, Hinting at RSI
items.summary_zh: 智谱披露GLM-5.3 初显RSI：模型开始优化承载自己的推理系统- OSCHINA - 开源 × AI · 开发者生态社区 OSCHINA
items.summary_en: Zhipu has disclosed progress on GLM-5.3, saying the model has begun optimizing the inference system that serves it — an early sign of RSI (recursive self-improvement). The report, carried by the OSCHINA open-source and AI developer community, offers no further technical details, benchmarks or timelines.
items.why_zh: 若模型真能优化承载自身运行的系统，意味着 AI 迭代可能加速到更难被人类监控的程度。
items.why_en: If a model can optimize the very system that runs it, AI iteration could accelerate beyond easy human oversight.

items.title_zh: 诉讼称 Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceXAI 与谷歌就“放缓 AI”达成非法协议
items.title_en: Lawsuit says Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google made illegal agreement on AI slowdown
items.summary_zh: 据 Herald-Banner 报道，一起诉讼指控 Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceXAI 与谷歌就放缓 AI 发展达成非法协议。报道未披露诉讼的具体原告、受理法院、指控依据以及被诉各方是否已作出回应等细节。若指控成立，核心争议将在于几家头部 AI 公司是否通过协同行为限制竞争，从而涉嫌违反反垄断法。这一案件出现在全球监管机构与公众对 AI 竞争格局高度敏感的背景下，后续进展值得关注。
items.summary_en: Lawsuit says Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google made illegal agreement on AI slowdown Herald-Banner
items.why_zh: 若头部 AI 公司被认定协同放缓研发，将直接触及反垄断法，并可能重塑行业竞争格局。
items.why_en: If leading AI firms are found to have coordinated on slowing development, it would raise direct antitrust exposure and could reshape competition in the sector.

items.summary_en: A new Chinese MoE flagship model has launched, ranking third among open-source models globally and pricing itself against DeepSeek-V4-Pro, per ZhiDongXi. The report did not name the model, its developer or its benchmark scores.
items.why_zh: 国产开源 MoE 模型排名与定价双双对标头部产品，说明开源大模型的竞争正转向性价比与生态卡位。
items.why_en: A Chinese open-source MoE model matching top-tier rankings and pricing shows competition shifting toward cost-performance and ecosystem positioning.

items.title_en: Aoni Delivers Day-0 Support, Fitting DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash onto a Single 8-GPU Machine

items.why_en: Same-day adaptation means enterprises can adopt the new model on their own hardware faster, lowering deployment barriers.

items.title_zh: 怕 AI“脱离管控”，Anthropic 和埃森哲豪掷 20 亿美元搞 AI 安全评估
items.title_en: Fearing AI Could Slip Out of Control, Anthropic and Accenture Each Commit $1B to AI Safety Evaluation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，人工智能实验室 Anthropic 于当地时间周五宣布，将与埃森哲（Accenture）开展合作，针对自身前沿人工智能模型开展独立评估；两家企业承诺，未来五年各自至少投入 10 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 67.18 亿元人民币） ，搭建开展该项工作所需的配套能力。 在这项合作落地之际，AI 研发企业正承受来自监管机构、其他企业以及研究人员越来越大的压力，各方都要求企业保证高级模型具备安全性与可靠性。 近期已经发生数起相关事件，包括部分 AI 智能体突破隔离运行环境。这也引发了人们的担忧：人工智能未来或许可以在人类少量介入的前提下推进自身迭代，这将使得 AI 的行为更难被监控与管控。 当地时间周六，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥 · 阿莫代伊（Dario Amodei）呼吁各家 AI 企业放缓前沿模型的开发节奏，同时向独立评估人员开放更大程度的系统访问权限。 竞争对手 OpenAI 则已于周三表态，将会定期发布报告，披露模型出现的各类异常或者值得警惕的行为，并且一次性对外发布了六份相关事件报告。 埃森哲旗下专门的 AI 业务部门 Faculty 将主导本次合作，负责对 Anthropic 的模型开展评估与红蓝对抗测试，完成对齐效果评估，同时检验模型的各项安全防护机制。 双方投入的资金将用于支撑 Anthropic 所称的驻场评估（embe…
items.summary_en: Anthropic said it will work with Accenture on independent evaluations of its frontier models, with each side committing at least $1 billion over five years. Accenture's AI unit Faculty will lead red-teaming, alignment and safeguard testing, amid rising pressure on labs and incidents of AI agents escaping sandboxed environments.
items.why_zh: 两大机构以巨额资金推动第三方独立安全评估，反映出行业在“AI 可能脱离管控”担忧下的自我约束尝试。
items.why_en: Two major players are funding third-party safety evaluation at scale, an industry attempt at self-restraint amid fears AI may slip out of human control.

items.why_en: A multi-billion-dollar round shows capital is still betting heavily on leading Chinese model makers, funding their compute and R&D.

items.title_zh: AI 是否需要反垄断豁免，才能避免“把所有人都干掉”？
items.title_en: Does AI need an antitrust exemption so it doesn’t kill everyone????
items.summary_zh: 在 Decoder 播客“商业的未来”两期系列的第一期中，主持人对话前拜登政府司法部反垄断负责人乔纳森·坎特（Jonathan Kanter）。他目前是圣路易斯华盛顿大学法学院教授，并在卡内基梅隆大学担任技术政策教授。节目聚焦当前科技界最热的争论——AI 安全与监管：包括 Anthropic、Google DeepMind 等大型 AI 实验室的研究人员以引人注目的方式离职，他们称模型构成真实威胁，而整个行业并未认真对待安全问题。讨论延伸至一个尖锐问题：AI 是否需要反垄断豁免，以免在“竞赛中失控”并造成灾难性后果。
items.summary_en: Today on Decoder , we’ve got the first of a two-part series on the future of business, and I’m talking with Jonathan Kanter, the former antitrust chief for the US Department of Justice in the Biden administration. These days, he’s both a professor of law at WashU and professor of technology policy at Carnegie Mellon. The biggest story in tech right now is the spiraling debate about AI safety and regulation . Researchers at the big AI labs including Anthropic and Google DeepMind have quit in noisy ways, saying the models pose real threats and safety isn’t being taken seriously across the…
items.why_zh: 把反垄断豁免与 AI 安全绑在一起讨论，触及了“放慢竞争”与“加速风险”之间最难取舍的监管悖论。
items.why_en: Framing an antitrust exemption as an AI-safety question captures the hardest regulatory trade-off between slowing competition and accelerating risk.

items.title_zh: 弗吉尼亚州长成立 AI 工作组，并出手约束数据中心
items.title_en: Virginia governor creates an AI task force and moves to restrain data centers
items.summary_zh: 弗吉尼亚州州长阿比盖尔·斯潘伯格发布行政命令，要求州政府采取措施，让地方社区在数据中心开发中拥有更大话语权，并放缓审批节奏——该州被称为“世界数据中心之都”。第 22 号行政命令禁止行政部门官员为数据中心项目签署保密协议，要求加快出台噪音监管规定，并强制审查数据中心使用的备用发电设备运行情况。命令同时设立一个 AI 工作组，负责评估该州的相关政策。报道指出，这些举措可能让地方在数据中心落地上的审批更慢、更透明。
items.summary_en: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger ordered the state government to take steps that could empower local communities to have a larger say in data center development and slow down approvals in a state that is already home to the data center capital of the world . Executive Order 22 bans executive branch officials from signing nondisclosure agreements for data center projects, requires expedited noise regulations, and requires a review of backup-generation operations used by data centers, among other requirements. The order also establishes an AI task force responsible for evaluating how the state g…
items.why_zh: 在全球数据中心最密集的州收紧审批与保密协议，可能成为美国地方层面约束 AI 基建扩张的风向标。
items.why_en: Tightening approvals and NDAs in the world's densest data center state could set a precedent for local limits on AI infrastructure buildout.

items.title_zh: 这只冷门软件股或成押注 Anthropic IPO 的隐秘通道
items.title_en: Buying This Hidden Software Stock Might Just Give You Massive Exposure to the Anthropic IPO

items.summary_zh: 文章指出，在近期几起高关注度黑客事件引发“AI 可能杀死全人类”的担忧之前，能源系统早已在 cyberattack 面前显得脆弱，而且风险还在上升。作者引述安全与技术研究院（IST）公共安全与韧性常驻高管 Joshua Corman 的比喻：我们一直是猎物，只是靠着捕食者的胃口勉强存活。他提到，此前自己关注的是美国国土安全部关于伊朗行为体及其同情者可能对美发动网络攻击的警告，如今再次致电 Corman 讨论最新形势。核心观点是：比起想象中的失控 AI，人（攻击者）才是当下能源系统最现实的威胁。
items.summary_en: Before recent high-profile hacks raised the specter of AI possibly " killing all humans ," our energy systems were already disturbingly vulnerable to cyberattack - and the risk is growing. "We were always prey. We were just kind of surviving at the appetite of our predators," Joshua Corman, executive in residence for public safety and resilience at the Institute for Security and Technology (IST), told me last year . At the time, I was preoccupied with a Department of Homeland Security warning that Iranian actors and sympathizers could target the US with cyberattacks. Last week, I called Corman…
items.why_zh: 在围绕 AI 风险的讨论升温之际，文章提醒人们：能源等关键基础设施最紧迫的安全威胁依然来自人类攻击者。
items.why_en: Amid rising AI-risk debates, it reminds us that the most urgent threat to critical infrastructure like energy still comes from human attackers.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，据 Arstechnica 报道，随着欧洲各国军队开始适应现代战争当中人工智能与无人机的应用，一家获得北约支持的初创企业正在协助部署由 AI 驱动的目标探测与筛选系统。这套系统可以直接在小型无人机上运行，用于侦察以及打击任务。 据IT之家了解，这家名为斯凯奥特系统（Scaleout Systems）的公司，由瑞典乌普萨拉大学的研究人员于 2018 年创立。公司早期的业务重心，是直接在商用卡车以及其他车辆的硬件上完成机器学习模型的训练与部署。但 2022 年俄乌战争爆发之后，该公司调整方向，转向防务领域。 “乌克兰战事爆发，加之全球局势发生转变，我们意识到这项技术十分重要。借助它，边缘端的数据与传感器数据就可以投入机器学习运算，从而帮助北约盟国建立战略优势。”斯凯奥特系统联合创始人兼首席执行官安德烈亚斯 · 赫兰德（Andreas Hellander）在接受采访时表示。 斯凯奥特并没有选用 OpenAI 或是 Anthropic 的前沿大模型，而是采用轻量化模型；这类机器学习模型能够直接在无人机硬件或是前沿基地的计算机上完成计算机视觉任务。“模型必须适配前沿部署设备与边缘硬件。这类硬件跨度很大，既有小型嵌入式装置，也有性能相当强劲的边缘工作站。”赫兰德说道。 2025 年，斯凯奥特入选北约北大西洋防务创新加速器（DIANA，Defence Innova…
items.summary_en: Scaleout Systems, a NATO-backed Swedish startup, is deploying AI-driven target detection and screening that runs directly on small drones for reconnaissance and strike missions, even without network connectivity. Founded in 2018 by Uppsala University researchers, the company pivoted to defense after the 2022 Ukraine war and uses lightweight models rather than large models from OpenAI or Anthropic. It was selected for NATO's DIANA accelerator in 2025.
items.why_zh: 轻量化 AI 模型让无人机在断网边缘端自主完成目标识别与打击，可能改变未来战场形态。
items.why_en: Lightweight AI models enabling offline, edge-based target detection and strikes on drones could reshape future warfare.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，苹果最新的 A20 Pro 芯片搭载双 16 核神经网络引擎，这在苹果自研 Apple Silicon 发展史上尚属首次。该神经网络引擎专为处理人工智能运算负载打造，性能超越此前所有 SoC。最新演示显示，一台 iPhone 18 Pro 运行 270 亿参数模型时，运行速度可达 iPhone 17 Pro 的两倍。 iPhone 18 Pro 以及 iPhone 18 Pro Max 均配备 12GB、96 位位宽的 LPDDR5X 内存，内存速度相比 iPhone 17 Pro、iPhone 17 Pro Max 的有明显提升。内存升级再加上这套双 16 核神经网络引擎，将手机端本地 AI 性能推上了全新台阶。网友阿德里安 · 格龙丁（Adrien Grondin）在 iPhone 18 Pro 上运行 Bonsai‑27B 模型，直观展示了性能提升效果；可以明显看到，模型生成词元（token）的速度十分惊人。 诚然，对于 iPhone 而言，可以离线运行体量更大的 270 亿参数 AI 模型属于重大进步，但用户也需要面对一些取舍。首先，X 平台的相关帖子就提出疑问：既然 Bonsai 2 已经发布，还有必要继续使用初代 Bonsai 吗？答案并不乐观，这也是智能手机本地运行 AI 模型不得不面对的残酷现实：采用 2 比特量化版本的 Bonsai…
items.summary_en: Apple's A20 Pro chip features dual 16-core neural engines, a first for Apple Silicon. Tests show iPhone 18 Pro runs a 27-billion-parameter model twice as fast as iPhone 17 Pro. With 12GB LPDDR5X memory, it achieves impressive token generation speeds. However, trade-offs remain, such as the impact of 2-bit quantization and whether the original Bonsai model is outdated after Bonsai 2's release.
items.why_zh: 展示端侧AI性能大幅提升，推动手机本地运行大模型成为可能。
items.why_en: Demonstrates significant on-device AI performance gains, making local large-model execution on phones increasingly viable.

items.title_zh: 最高悬赏 10 万美元，英特尔突然关停漏洞赏金计划
items.title_en: Intel Suddenly Shuts Down Bug Bounty Program with Rewards Up to $100,000
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，据 Notebookcheck 报道，英特尔已经暂停其运行已久的漏洞赏金计划，转而在 Intigriti 平台启用一套全新的漏洞上报机制，新体系不再提供任何现金奖励。英特尔原先的计划会为发现安全漏洞的研究人员提供最高 10 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 67.2 万元人民币） 的奖励；而现在英特尔在 Intigriti 平台上的项目已明确标注为负责任披露项目，取消赏金。 研究人员依旧可以提交在英特尔硬件、固件、软件以及开源项目当中发现的漏洞，但相关发现不再能够获得现金报酬。旧版漏洞赏金计划于 2017 年以受邀参与模式启动，2018 年向全体安全研究者开放。该计划成效显著，能够在恶意攻击者利用漏洞之前完成高危缺陷的修复。 仅 2020 年一年，英特尔修复的通用漏洞披露编号（CVE）当中就有将近一半直接来自该赏金计划。奖金原先分为四个等级：轻微漏洞 250 美元 （现汇率约合 1,680 元人民币） ，最高等级的严重漏洞可达 10 万美元 （现汇率约合 67.2 万元人民币） 。就在 2025 年年初，英特尔还表示正在评估优化赏金评定标准；因此本次突然叫停赏金机制，令整个网络安全行业感到意外。 英特尔尚未就此次暂停发布官方解释，但行业发展趋势显示，人工智能兴起很可能是背后诱因。近期各类开源项目收到了大量由 AI 工具自动生成的安全报告。Linux…
items.summary_en: Intel has suspended its long-running bug bounty program and switched to a new mechanism on Intigriti that offers no cash rewards. The original program offered up to $100,000 and was highly effective, with nearly half of CVEs fixed in 2020 coming from it. Intel has not explained the move, but industry speculates it may be due to AI-generated security reports. The decision surprised the cybersecurity community.
items.why_zh: 可能反映AI生成漏洞报告对传统赏金计划的冲击，影响安全研究生态。
items.why_en: May reflect the impact of AI-generated vulnerability reports on traditional bounty programs, affecting the security research ecosystem.

items.title_zh: Anthropic据称将于11月启动IPO，面临AI放缓与反垄断诉讼
items.title_en: Anthropic Said to Launch November IPO Amid New AI Slowdown and Antitrust Lawsuits Ahead of Listing
items.summary_zh: 据贸易关键（TradingKey）报道，AI公司Anthropic计划在11月进行首次公开募股（IPO）。然而，在上市前夕，该公司面临AI发展放缓以及反垄断诉讼的挑战。具体细节尚未披露，但此举可能使其成为又一家上市的AI独角兽。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Said to Launch November IPO Amid New AI Slowdown and Antitrust Lawsuits Ahead of Listing tradingkey.com
items.why_zh: Anthropic作为重要AI公司，其IPO将测试市场对AI行业的信心。
items.why_en: As a major AI company, Anthropic's IPO will test market confidence in the AI sector.

items.title_zh: 英伟达可能为Anthropic的大规模IPO提供资金
items.title_en: Nvidia may bankroll Anthropic's massive IPO
items.summary_zh: 据Mashable报道，英伟达可能为Anthropic的大规模IPO提供资金支持。此举若成真，将进一步加强英伟达在AI领域的布局，并可能影响Anthropic的上市进程。具体投资形式和金额尚未明确。
items.summary_en: Nvidia may bankroll Anthropic's massive IPO Mashable
items.why_zh: 英伟达的潜在支持凸显AI芯片巨头与模型公司日益紧密的资本联系。
items.why_en: Nvidia's potential backing highlights the growing capital ties between AI chip giants and model companies.

items.title_zh: 刚刚，中国最大独立Token工厂又融资，年内已融29亿
items.title_en: China's Largest Independent Token Factory Raises Again, 2.9B Yuan This Year
items.summary_zh: 刚刚，中国最大独立Token工厂又融资，年内已融29亿 智东西
items.summary_en: A company described as China's largest independent token factory has closed another funding round, bringing its total raised this year to 2.9 billion yuan, according to Zhidx. The report did not disclose the size, investors or valuation of the latest round. The pace of fundraising highlights growing investor interest in AI inference and token-serving infrastructure.
items.why_zh: 独立 Token 工厂持续获投，反映出推理侧算力与 Token 服务正成为 AI 基础设施投资的新焦点。
items.why_en: Repeated funding for independent token factories shows inference-side compute and token services are becoming a key focus of AI infrastructure investment.

items.title_zh: 二代豆包手机销售额一秒破亿！苹果、华为同步押注，AI手机大战一触即发
items.title_en: Second-Gen Doubao Phone Hits 100M Yuan in One Second as Apple and Huawei Bet on AI Phones
items.summary_zh: 二代豆包手机销售额一秒破亿！苹果、华为同步押注，AI手机大战一触即发 中华网财经
items.summary_en: Sales of the second-generation Doubao phone topped 100 million yuan within one second of launch, according to Chinanet Finance. Apple and Huawei are simultaneously betting on AI phones, setting the stage for a broader battle over the category. The report did not detail the device's specs, pricing or how sales were measured.
items.why_zh: AI 手机销量与头部厂商的同步押注，表明大模型向终端下沉正成为智能手机竞争的主战场。
items.why_en: Strong AI phone sales and simultaneous bets by Apple and Huawei signal that on-device AI is becoming the main battleground for smartphones.

items.title_zh: 南向资金本周净买入智谱超70亿港元 16股持股量环比增长超10%
items.title_en: Southbound Funds Net Buy Over HK$7B of Zhipu This Week; 16 Stocks See Holdings Up 10%+
items.summary_zh: 南向资金本周净买入智谱超70亿港元 16股持股量环比增长超10% Sohu
items.summary_en: Southbound funds net bought more than HK$7 billion worth of Zhipu shares this week, with 16 stocks seeing their southbound holdings rise over 10% month-on-month, according to Sohu. Zhipu was among the biggest recipients of mainland capital flows, signaling rising allocation interest in AI-related assets.
items.why_zh: 南向资金大幅加仓智谱，反映出内地资金对 AI 大模型上市标的的配置热情正在上升。
items.why_en: Heavy southbound buying of Zhipu reflects growing mainland investor appetite for listed large-model AI companies.

items.title_zh: 南向资金本周净买120亿，智谱独揽77亿成最大赢家
items.title_en: Southbound Funds Net Buy HK$12B This Week, With Zhipu Taking HK$7.7B
items.summary_zh: 南向资金本周净买120亿，智谱独揽77亿成最大赢家 Sohu
items.summary_en: Southbound funds net bought about HK$12 billion this week, with Zhipu alone accounting for roughly HK$7.7 billion, according to Sohu. That makes Zhipu the biggest winner of the week and implies unusually high concentration in a single AI stock. No further details on trading dates or the nature of the flows were disclosed.
items.why_zh: 单只 AI 标的占据南向资金过半净买入，凸显资金对智谱的高度集中配置。
items.why_en: One AI stock absorbing more than half of weekly southbound net buying highlights extremely concentrated bets on Zhipu.

items.title_zh: 智谱为什么还需要融资
items.title_en: Why Does Zhipu Still Need to Raise Money?
items.summary_zh: 智谱为什么还需要融资 富途牛牛
items.summary_en: A Futu article examines why Zhipu continues to raise capital even after going public, looking at the drivers behind its funding needs. The piece comes amid heavy southbound buying of the stock and recent news about its borrowing and data-handling policies. No specific figures from the article were provided.
items.why_zh: 上市后仍持续融资，说明大模型公司在算力与研发上的资金消耗依然巨大。
items.why_en: Continued fundraising after listing shows large-model companies still burn enormous capital on compute and R&D.

items.title_zh: 诉讼称 Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceXAI 与 Google 达成非法的“放缓 AI”协议
items.title_en: Lawsuit Says Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google Made Illegal AI Slowdown Agreement
items.summary_zh: 据 Broadband Breakfast 报道，一起诉讼指控 Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceXAI 与 Google 达成了非法的“放缓 AI”协议，即相关公司被指通过协同方式限制 AI 发展节奏。该指控将矛头指向头部 AI 实验室之间的竞争与协作边界问题。若指控成立，可能涉及反垄断或协同行为方面的法律责任。原文未披露诉讼的原告、管辖法院及具体诉求等细节。
items.summary_en: Lawsuit Says Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google Made Illegal AI Slowdown Agreement Broadband Breakfast
items.why_zh: 若头部 AI 实验室被认定协同限制竞争，可能对整个行业的竞争规则与监管走向产生重大影响。
items.why_en: If leading AI labs are found to have coordinated to restrain competition, it could reshape industry competition rules and regulation.

items.title_zh: 智谱借了30亿美元“0 利息”借款，究竟是怎么回事？
items.title_en: What's Behind Zhipu's US$3 Billion "Zero-Interest" Borrowing?
items.summary_zh: 智谱借了30亿美元“0 利息”借款，究竟是怎么回事？ 创业邦
items.summary_en: A Chuangyebang article unpacks a US$3 billion "zero-interest" borrowing arrangement involving Zhipu. Such a structure implies extremely low funding costs and may reflect a specific deal or strategic relationship. The report did not disclose the loan's term, lender or guarantee terms.
items.why_zh: 如此规模的零利息融资安排，关系到智谱的资金成本与后续算力投入能力。
items.why_en: A zero-interest facility of this size bears directly on Zhipu's funding costs and its ability to keep investing in compute.

items.title_zh: 智谱上线“零数据留存”机制
items.title_en: Zhipu Rolls Out "Zero Data Retention" Mechanism
items.summary_zh: 智谱上线“零数据留存”机制 东方财富
items.summary_en: Zhipu has launched a "zero data retention" mechanism, according to East Money, meaning user-related data is not retained during service. Such policies are typically seen as key compliance features for enterprise and sensitive scenarios. The report did not specify which products the mechanism covers or when it took effect.
items.why_zh: 零数据留存直接回应企业客户对隐私合规的顾虑，是大模型商业化落地的关键竞争点。
items.why_en: Zero data retention directly addresses enterprise privacy compliance concerns, a key competitive factor for commercializing large models.

items.title_zh: 中金公司牵头协助智谱完成约50亿美元港股配售及境外可转债发行
items.title_en: CICC Leads Zhipu's ~$5B Hong Kong Placement and Offshore Convertible Bond Issuance
items.summary_zh: 中金公司牵头协助智谱完成约50亿美元港股配售及境外可转债发行 东方财富
items.summary_en: CICC led Zhipu's roughly $5 billion Hong Kong share placement and offshore convertible bond issuance, according to East Money. The deal combines equity and debt financing tools to raise substantial capital for the Chinese AI model developer.
items.why_zh: 这笔约50亿美元的融资规模在中国大模型公司中极为罕见，凸显资本对头部AI厂商的持续加注。
items.why_en: At roughly $5 billion, the raise is unusually large for a Chinese LLM company, underscoring sustained investor appetite for leading AI developers.

items.title_zh: 智谱ZCode回应数据上传争议：功能默认开启致数据上传 将开源代码
items.title_en: Zhipu's ZCode Responds to Data-Upload Controversy, Pledges to Open-Source Code
items.summary_zh: 智谱ZCode回应数据上传争议：功能默认开启致数据上传 将开源代码 东方财富
items.summary_en: Zhipu's ZCode coding tool addressed a data-upload controversy, saying uploads occurred because the feature was enabled by default, and pledged to open-source its code. The move aims to restore trust over data handling.
items.why_zh: AI编程工具的数据流向直接关系开发者信任，开源承诺是厂商应对信任危机的关键一步。
items.why_en: Data flows in AI coding tools are a core developer-trust issue, making the open-source pledge a critical trust-repair step.

items.title_zh: 获a16z投资的Vals力图成为AI基准测试的“黄金标准”
items.title_en: Vals, backed by Andreessen Horowitz, is looking to become the gold standard for AI benchmarking
items.summary_zh: 据TechCrunch报道，获得Andreessen Horowitz投资的Vals AI，正致力于成为AI基准测试领域的“黄金标准”。在AI模型数量激增、评测信息日益混乱的背景下，Vals希望把AI基准测试打造成更中立、更可信的资源。该公司试图解决的问题是：当新模型层出不穷时，业界缺乏公认、客观的评测参照。若其目标实现，将影响模型能力的评判方式与行业竞争格局。
items.summary_en: Vals AI is hoping to make AI benchmarking a more neutral and trustworthy resource in a world increasingly inundated by AI models.
items.why_zh: 在模型泛滥、评测标准混乱的当下，中立可信的基准测试可能成为行业评判模型能力的重要基础设施。
items.why_en: With models proliferating and evaluations muddled, neutral, trustworthy benchmarks could become key infrastructure for judging AI capability.

items.title_zh: AI监管之争尚未落幕：Anthropic提出三步计划，多位CEO表态支持
items.title_en: The AI regulation smackdown isn’t over
items.summary_zh: 本周伊始，AI界的重量级人物似乎至少在初步层面站在了支持AI监管的一边。Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei提出放缓AI发展的三步计划：在实验室中引入第三方评估者、在国内产业内进行协调，以及借助政府力量推动国际协议。OpenAI CEO Sam Altman、Google DeepMind联合创始人Demis Hassabis，甚至SpaceX CEO Elon Musk都公开对这三方面的部分内容表示认同。Anthropic与OpenAI此前也已释放出相关信号。文章指出，围绕AI监管的角力远未结束。
items.summary_en: At the start of this week, the who's-who of AI seemed - at least tentatively - on the side of AI regulation. Over the weekend, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei had proposed a three-step plan for slowing AI development, including by embedding third-party evaluators in labs, coordinating across the domestic industry, and forging international agreements potentially with government assistance. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Google DeepMind co-founder Demis Hassabis, and even SpaceX CEO Elon Musk publicly seemed to agree on aspects of all three things. Anthropic and OpenAI had already been dropping hints that t…
items.why_zh: 多家头部AI公司掌门人罕见地在监管方向上出现交集，可能影响未来AI安全政策的走向。
items.why_en: Rare alignment among top AI leaders on regulation could shape the direction of future AI safety policy.

items.title_zh: 华为发布制造与大企业七大方案与两项计划，加速行业AI 价值落地：发布制造与大企业DIMAK 特训营，联合伙伴推出七大行业解决方案、“鸿企100” 开源鸿蒙伙伴发展计划及全新全球样板点– 智慧城市行业分析
items.title_en: Huawei Unveils Seven Industry Solutions and Two Programs to Accelerate Enterprise AI Adoption
items.summary_zh: 华为发布制造与大企业七大方案与两项计划，加速行业AI 价值落地：发布制造与大企业DIMAK 特训营，联合伙伴推出七大行业解决方案、“鸿企100” 开源鸿蒙伙伴发展计划及全新全球样板点– 智慧城市行业分析 智慧城市行业分析
items.summary_en: Huawei launched seven industry solutions and two programs for manufacturing and large enterprises, including the DIMAK training camp, the 'Hongqi 100' OpenHarmony partner program and new global showcase sites, to speed enterprise AI adoption.
items.why_zh: 华为以方案加生态加人才的方式推进行业AI落地，反映AI竞争正从模型转向产业场景。
items.why_en: Huawei's solutions-plus-ecosystem-plus-talent push shows AI competition shifting from models to industrial deployment.

items.title_zh: 智谱完成配售及发债 净筹近400亿港元
items.title_en: Zhipu Raises Nearly HK$40 Billion Net via Placement and Bond Issuance
items.summary_zh: 智谱完成配售及发债 净筹近400亿港元 东方财富
items.summary_en: Zhipu completed a share placement and bond issuance, raising nearly HK$40 billion net, according to East Money. The combined equity-and-debt raise gives the AI developer substantial capital for R&D and expansion.
items.why_zh: 如此规模的募资为智谱的模型研发和算力投入提供了强力弹药，也体现头部AI公司的资本密集特征。
items.why_en: A raise of this scale arms Zhipu for costly model R&D and compute, highlighting how capital-intensive top-tier AI development has become.

items.title_zh: 涨价！智谱上线GLM-5.3-FlashX 定价提升至原版本的2.5倍
items.title_en: Zhipu Launches GLM-5.3-FlashX With Pricing 2.5x Higher
items.summary_zh: 涨价！智谱上线GLM-5.3-FlashX 定价提升至原版本的2.5倍 东方财富
items.summary_en: Zhipu launched GLM-5.3-FlashX with pricing set at 2.5 times the previous version, according to East Money, signaling higher costs for users of the new model.
items.why_zh: 模型定价上调反映推理成本压力与产品分层策略，也将影响开发者的模型选择。
items.why_en: Higher model pricing reflects inference-cost pressure and product tiering, which will influence developers' model choices.

items.title_zh: 纽森下令加快AI安全监管，并探索“一键关停”机制
items.title_en: Newsom Orders Faster AI Safety Oversight, Explores ‘Kill Switch’
items.summary_zh: 据Santa Monica Mirror报道，加州州长Gavin Newsom下令加快AI安全监管的推进速度，并正在探索所谓“一键关停”（kill switch）机制。此举显示加州在AI治理上采取更主动的姿态，试图通过加快监管流程与引入紧急干预手段来应对AI风险。相关动向可能对在加州运营的AI企业产生影响，也为其他地区的AI立法提供参考。
items.summary_en: Newsom Orders Faster AI Safety Oversight, Explores ‘Kill Switch’ Santa Monica Mirror
items.why_zh: 作为美国AI产业重镇，加州的监管动向可能成为全美AI安全立法的风向标。
items.why_en: As a major US AI hub, California's regulatory moves could set the tone for AI safety legislation nationwide.

items.title_zh: 利用4D AI模型和数字孪生构建虚拟细胞，有望加速药物发现
items.title_en: Virtual cells built from 4D AI models and 'digital twins' could speed up drug discovery
items.summary_zh: 科学家提出利用4D AI模型和“数字孪生”技术构建虚拟细胞，有望加速药物发现过程。这种方法可以模拟细胞在时间和空间上的动态行为，帮助研究人员更快地测试药物效果，减少对传统实验的依赖。如果成功，将大幅缩短新药研发周期，降低研发成本。
items.summary_en: Virtual cells built from 4D AI models and 'digital twins' could speed up drug discovery Phys.org
items.why_zh: 虚拟细胞技术可能变革药物研发模式，加速新药上市。
items.why_en: Virtual cell technology could transform drug discovery and accelerate new drug development.

items.title_zh: AI学会用西班牙语演唱，拉丁艺术家呼吁获得报酬
items.title_en: AI learned to sing in Spanish. Latin artists need to get paid.
items.summary_zh: 人工智能已学会用西班牙语演唱，这引发了拉丁音乐艺术家的担忧。他们呼吁确保自己的作品和声音在AI训练与生成中被合理使用并获得报酬。随着AI音乐生成技术日益成熟，版权和补偿问题成为行业焦点。
items.summary_en: AI learned to sing in Spanish. Latin artists need to get paid. The Hill
items.why_zh: AI生成音乐冲击传统版权体系，艺术家权益亟待保护。
items.why_en: AI-generated music disrupts traditional copyright frameworks, highlighting the need to protect artists' rights.

items.title_zh: 北京将焦点转向AI国家安全风险
items.title_en: Beijing shifts focus to AI national security risks — Dawn
items.summary_zh: 据Dawn报道，北京正将注意力转向人工智能带来的国家安全风险。此举可能意味着中国将加强对AI技术的监管，特别是在军事、情报和关键基础设施等领域的应用。这一政策转向可能影响全球AI治理格局。
items.summary_en: Beijing shifts focus to AI national security risks — Dawn UA.NEWS
items.why_zh: 中国AI政策转向国家安全，可能重塑全球AI监管与竞争态势。
items.why_en: China's pivot to AI national security risks could reshape global AI regulation and competition.

items.title_zh: AI代理自主达成协议并行动，机器比人类更聪明，委托人只是同意
items.title_en: AI agents are agreeing and acting: machines are now smarter than humans. Their principals merely agree
items.summary_zh: 《财富》文章指出，AI代理已能自主达成协议并采取行动，机器智能在某些方面已超越人类，而它们的人类委托人往往只是被动同意。这引发了关于责任归属和人类控制权的深刻问题。随着AI代理在商业和社交中日益活跃，如何确保人类保持最终决策权成为紧迫挑战。
items.summary_en: AI agents are agreeing and acting: machines are now smarter than humans. Their principals merely agree Fortune
items.why_zh: AI代理自主性增强，人类控制权与责任归属面临考验。
items.why_en: Increasing AI agent autonomy challenges human control and accountability.

items.title_zh: 休斯顿，我们有麻烦了：人工智能正变得越来越难控制
items.title_en: Houston, We Have a Problem: Artificial Intelligence Is Becoming Harder to Control
items.summary_zh: 一篇Hackernoon文章警告，人工智能正变得越来越难以控制。随着AI系统日益复杂和自主，确保其行为符合人类意图的难度不断加大。这引发了关于AI安全、对齐研究和监管必要性的讨论。
items.summary_en: Houston, We Have a Problem: Artificial Intelligence Is Becoming Harder to Control hackernoon.com
items.why_zh: AI可控性下降，凸显AI安全与对齐研究的紧迫性。
items.why_en: Declining AI controllability highlights the urgency of AI safety and alignment research.

items.title_zh: Anthropic：如何衡量前沿实验室内部AI发展速度
items.title_en: Measurements for understanding the pace of AI development inside frontier labs
items.summary_zh: Anthropic发表文章，探讨如何衡量前沿实验室内部AI发展的速度。文章可能提出一系列指标和方法，以更准确地追踪AI能力的进步，帮助研究人员和政策制定者理解AI发展的真实节奏。这对于预测AI影响和制定相应策略至关重要。
items.summary_en: Measurements for understanding the pace of AI development inside frontier labs Anthropic
items.why_zh: 量化AI发展速度有助于预判风险并制定政策。
items.why_en: Quantifying AI development pace helps anticipate risks and inform policy.

items.title_zh: 入侵OpenAI的黑客警告：AI行业存在安全问题
items.title_en: Hackers who broke into OpenAI warn the AI industry has a security problem
items.summary_zh: 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，曾入侵OpenAI的黑客警告称，AI行业存在严重的安全问题。这些黑客可能利用了OpenAI系统中的漏洞，他们的警告凸显了AI公司在保护模型和用户数据方面面临的挑战。随着AI技术广泛应用，安全性成为行业亟待解决的关键议题。
items.summary_en: Hackers who broke into OpenAI warn the AI industry has a security problem The Washington Post
items.why_zh: AI行业安全漏洞可能危及模型与数据，需加强防护。
items.why_en: Security vulnerabilities in the AI industry could endanger models and data, necessitating stronger protections.

items.title_zh: Claude Opus 5被用于OpenAI破解，研究人员获1.15亿印尼盾奖金
items.title_en: Claude Opus 5 Used by Bobol OpenAI Crack, Researchers Receive Rp115 Million Prize
items.summary_zh: 据VOI.ID报道，Claude Opus 5被用于对OpenAI的破解（或入侵）中，相关研究人员因此获得了1.15亿印尼盾的奖金。这一事件可能涉及AI模型在网络安全攻防中的应用，以及漏洞赏金计划。但具体细节尚不明确。
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5 Used by Bobol OpenAI Crack, Researchers Receive Rp115 Million Prize VOI.ID
items.why_zh: AI模型被用于攻击事件，凸显AI安全双刃剑效应。
items.why_en: AI models used in attacks highlight the double-edged sword of AI security.

items.title_zh: IT之家专访苹果 iPhone 营销副总裁凯安 · 德兰斯：iPhone Duo 追求最终用户体验，而不仅仅是为了技术
items.title_en: Apple iPhone Marketing VP Kaiann Drance Interview: iPhone Duo Pursues Ultimate User Experience
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，北京时间 9 月 10 日凌晨 1 点，苹果传闻已久的首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 终于亮相，iPhone 18 Pro 系列同步上新，这也是新任 CEO 约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）执掌苹果后的首秀。 9 月 17 日，苹果全球 iPhone 产品市场营销副总裁 凯安 · 德兰斯（Kaiann Drance） 在上海接受了IT之家专访，谈到关于 iPhone Duo 和 iPhone 18 Pro 的一些设计理念。 IT之家： iPhone 18 Pro 售价上调，但外观设计延续上代，直观的硬件改动不多，光圈等对普通消费者也过于抽象，iPhone 18 Pro 会靠哪些体验打动消费者呢？ 凯安 · 德兰斯： 当然，首先回答您关于光圈的问题。我们研发的可变光圈的精妙之处在于， 即使你不懂如何使用光圈，或者不是使用 Pro 级控制选项的专业人士，可变光圈都可以帮助日常拍摄的照片和视频看起来效果更好 ，自动调整进光量，所以用户即使在弱光下也能拍摄出兼具清晰度、景深效果的最佳照片。 除了相机功能，得益于 A20 芯片，（iPhone 18 Pro 系列的）性能也得到了巨大的提升，这不是简单常规的年度升级，CPU 性能提升了 20%、GPU 性能提升高达 40%，NPU 核心数和神经网络引擎数量翻倍，现在有多达 32 个核心，都建立在…
items.summary_en: Apple's first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, launched on Sept 10 alongside the iPhone 18 Pro series, marking new CEO John Ternus's first product event. On Sept 17, Apple's global VP of iPhone product marketing Kaiann Drance told IT之家 in Shanghai that the iPhone 18 Pro's variable aperture automatically adjusts light intake so ordinary users can take better low-light photos, and that the A20 chip delivers major performance gains: 20% faster CPU, up to 40% faster GPU, and doubled NPU cores to 32.
items.why_zh: 苹果首款折叠屏与新一代 Pro 机型的设计理念，反映了苹果在硬件升级趋缓时如何以体验驱动说服消费者。
items.why_en: Apple's first foldable and new Pro lineup's design philosophy shows how Apple tries to win consumers through experience as hardware upgrades slow.

items.title_zh: 特朗普与儿子大举投资 AI 经济，同时抵制放缓呼声
items.title_en: Trump and sons invest heavily in AI economy as he resists calls for slowdown
items.summary_zh: 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，美国总统特朗普及其儿子正在人工智能经济领域进行大举投资，与此同时，特朗普本人抵制要求放缓 AI 发展步伐的呼声。报道聚焦特朗普家族在 AI 领域的商业布局与其政策立场之间的关联。目前披露的信息未给出具体投资规模或项目细节，但事件反映出 AI 投资热潮与安全监管诉求之间的持续张力。
items.summary_en: Trump and sons invest heavily in AI economy as he resists calls for slowdown The Washington Post
items.why_zh: 特朗普家族在 AI 领域的投资与其抵制放缓 AI 的立场交织，可能影响美国 AI 监管与产业政策走向。
items.why_en: The Trump family's AI investments and his resistance to slowing AI development could shape U.S. AI regulation and industrial policy.

items.title_zh: Will AI save or destroy us? At Pittsburgh summit, tech leaders shift between hope and despair
items.title_en: Will AI Save or Destroy Us? At Pittsburgh Summit, Tech Leaders Shift Between Hope and Despair
items.summary_zh: Will AI save or destroy us? At Pittsburgh summit, tech leaders shift between hope and despair Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
items.summary_en: At a Pittsburgh summit, tech leaders oscillated between hope and despair over AI's future, according to the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette. They expressed optimism about AI's potential while voicing deep concerns about its risks, reflecting the industry's divided outlook.
items.why_zh: 科技领袖在 AI 前景上的分歧，凸显了在创新加速与安全担忧之间寻求平衡的紧迫性。
items.why_en: The split among tech leaders underscores the urgent need to balance AI innovation with safety concerns.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 称 Claude 主导其自身 26% 的 AI 研发
items.title_en: Anthropic Says Claude Leads 26% of Its Own AI R&D [2026]
items.summary_zh: 据 shattered.io 报道，Anthropic 表示其 AI 模型 Claude 已经主导了公司自身 AI 研发工作中的 26%。这意味着 Claude 在 Anthropic 的研发流程中承担了相当比例的引领或执行角色，而非仅作为辅助工具。该数据指向 AI 正在越来越多地参与甚至推动自身迭代的研发环节。报道未提供该比例的统计口径或具体任务范围。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Says Claude Leads 26% of Its Own AI R&D [2026] shattered.io
items.why_zh: 若 AI 已能主导自身四分之一以上的研发，将加速 AI 迭代并引发对递归自我改进的讨论。
items.why_en: If AI already leads over a quarter of its own R&D, it could accelerate AI iteration and raise questions about recursive self-improvement.

items.title_zh: “On the Record”：学校应如何使用 AI？
items.title_en: 'On the Record': How should AI be used in schools?
items.summary_zh: WPBF 的“On the Record”节目探讨了学校应如何使用人工智能。报道聚焦教育场景中 AI 的应用边界、潜在益处与风险，可能涉及学生使用、教师角色和学术诚信等议题。由于仅有标题信息，具体讨论内容未披露，但该话题反映出 AI 进入课堂后引发的政策与实践争议。
items.summary_en: 'On the Record': How should AI be used in schools? WPBF
items.why_zh: AI 进入校园带来教学创新与学术诚信之间的张力，教育界亟需明确使用规范。
items.why_en: AI in schools creates tension between innovation and academic integrity, making clear guidelines urgent.

items.title_zh: 白帽黑客用 Claude 不到72小时攻破 OpenAI 内部系统，6500美元漏洞赏金引发行业热议
items.title_en: White-Hat Hacker Breaches OpenAI Internal System Using Claude in Under 72 Hours, $6,500 Bug Bounty Sparks Viral Industry Debate
items.summary_zh: 据 36氪 报道，一名白帽黑客利用 Claude 在不到72小时内攻破了 OpenAI 的内部系统，并因此获得 6500 美元的漏洞赏金。该事件在行业内迅速传播，引发关于 AI 模型安全性的激烈讨论。争议焦点在于：Claude 被用于协助发现或利用漏洞，既展示了 AI 作为安全工具的潜力，也让人担忧 AI 可能被滥用于攻击。报道未披露漏洞的具体性质或 OpenAI 的正式回应。
items.summary_en: White-Hat Hacker Breaches OpenAI Internal System Using Claude in Under 72 Hours, $6,500 Bug Bounty Sparks Viral Industry Debate 36氪
items.why_zh: 该事件凸显 AI 模型在网络安全攻防中的双刃剑效应，可能推动漏洞赏金和安全评估方式变革。
items.why_en: The incident highlights AI's double-edged role in cybersecurity, potentially reshaping bug bounties and security assessments.

items.title_zh: FBI控中企抄袭 美官网赫见中国AI搜索工具后下架
items.title_en: FBI Accuses Chinese Firm of Copying; Chinese AI Search Tool Appears on U.S. Government Website Before Removal
items.summary_zh: FBI控中企抄袭 美官网赫见中国AI搜索工具后下架 文学城
items.summary_en: The FBI accused a Chinese company of copying, and a Chinese AI search tool appeared on a U.S. government website before being removed, according to 文学城. The incident adds to U.S.-China tech tensions and intellectual property disputes. Details on the company and tool were not provided.
items.why_zh: 中国 AI 工具现身美国政府官网并被下架，叠加 FBI 抄袭指控，可能加剧中美在 AI 领域的互不信任。
items.why_en: A Chinese AI tool appearing on and then being removed from a U.S. government site, alongside FBI copying allegations, could deepen U.S.-China mistrust in AI.

items.title_zh: AI 安全悖论
items.title_en: The AI safety paradox
items.summary_zh: 《西雅图时报》发表文章探讨“AI 安全悖论”。标题暗示 AI 安全领域存在某种自相矛盾之处，可能涉及：过度监管可能阻碍有益创新，而放任发展又可能带来风险；或者安全措施本身可能被用于增强 AI 能力。由于仅有标题信息，文章的具体论点未披露，但该话题反映了当前 AI 治理中难以兼顾安全与发展的困境。
items.summary_en: The AI safety paradox The Seattle Times
items.why_zh: 识别并厘清 AI 安全中的悖论，有助于避免监管陷入非此即彼的困境，推动更务实的治理。
items.why_en: Clarifying the AI safety paradox can help avoid binary regulation and foster more pragmatic governance.

items.title_zh: 俄勒冈大学研究发现政府影响AI回答
items.title_en: University of Oregon study finds government influence on AI responses
items.summary_zh: 美国俄勒冈大学的一项研究发现，政府会对AI生成的回答产生影响。该研究由该校开展，具体细节尚未在报道中充分披露，但结论表明政府可能以某种方式介入或塑造人工智能系统的输出内容。这一发现引发了对AI中立性与信息可信度的关注，并可能推动关于AI治理与监管的进一步讨论。报道来自KOIN.com，目前尚不清楚研究涉及哪些具体的AI系统或政府行为，但已引起外界对AI回答是否受政治力量影响的担忧。
items.summary_en: University of Oregon study finds government influence on AI responses KOIN.com
items.why_zh: 该研究提示政府可能影响AI输出，凸显AI中立性与治理的重要性。
items.why_en: The study suggests governments may influence AI outputs, underscoring concerns about AI neutrality and governance.

items.title_zh: AI生成的虚假美国情报凸显中美AI安全合作的紧迫性：专家
items.title_en: False AI-generated US intelligence highlights urgent need for China-US cooperation on AI safety: experts
items.summary_zh: 据《环球时报》报道，一份由AI生成的虚假美国情报引发了关注，专家指出这一事件凸显了中美在AI安全领域开展合作的紧迫性。该虚假情报的内容和传播途径尚未详细披露，但专家认为，AI被用于生成虚假信息可能带来严重风险，需要两国共同应对。他们呼吁加强对话与协作，以防范AI技术被滥用于制造虚假情报或误导公众。这一事件再次提醒国际社会关注AI安全治理。
items.summary_en: False AI-generated US intelligence highlights urgent need for China-US cooperation on AI safety: experts Global Times
items.why_zh: 该事件表明AI可被用于制造虚假情报，凸显中美合作应对AI安全风险的紧迫性。
items.why_en: The incident shows AI can be used to create false intelligence, highlighting the urgency of China-US cooperation on AI safety.

items.title_zh: “不能让中国追上”，美国AI巨头越来越鹰，比起人工智能可能毁灭人类，他们更怕中国崛起
items.title_en: 'Can't let China catch up': US AI giants grow hawkish, fear China's rise more than AI destroying humanity
items.summary_zh: “不能让中国追上”，美国AI巨头越来越鹰，比起人工智能可能毁灭人类，他们更怕中国崛起 新浪新闻_手机新浪网
items.summary_en: A Sina News report says US AI giants are becoming increasingly hawkish, fearing China's rise more than AI's existential threat to humanity. Their "can't let China catch up" stance could shape US AI policy toward tougher measures against China and overshadow AI safety concerns.
items.why_zh: 美国AI巨头的鹰派立场可能将AI竞争推向地缘政治对抗，影响全球AI治理与合作。
items.why_en: The hawkish stance of US AI giants could turn AI competition into geopolitical confrontation, affecting global AI governance and cooperation.

items.title_zh: 我们应如何担忧AI对人类的存在性威胁？
items.title_en: How concerned should we be about AI's supposed existential threat to humanity?
items.summary_zh: 法国《世界报》刊文探讨人工智能被指对人类构成存在性威胁的问题，分析我们应当对此抱有多大程度的担忧。文章梳理了关于AI可能带来生存风险的种种论点，并审视这些担忧是否被夸大或忽视。报道旨在帮助读者理解AI风险辩论中的不同立场，以及如何理性看待AI的长期影响。文章没有给出简单结论，而是呈现多方观点，强调在AI快速发展背景下保持审慎与开放讨论的重要性。
items.summary_en: How concerned should we be about AI's supposed existential threat to humanity? Le Monde.fr
items.why_zh: 该报道促使公众理性思考AI存在性威胁的论争，对AI风险认知与政策讨论具有参考价值。
items.why_en: The article encourages a rational look at the debate over AI's existential threat, informing public risk perception and policy discussions.
